issues.detail: The Greek 'δια λογου' (dia logou) in this context means 'by means of words' or 'verbally', describing the *method* of communication. The Vietnamese translation 'chính họ sẽ dùng lời nói báo cáo lại' implies a specific intent/purpose of 'reporting back' (báo cáo lại), which adds a nuance of reporting to an authority that is not explicitly in the Greek text.
